scope: Read-only diagnosis of the local release-gate membership refusal and fresh CI spend read; no source, account, membership, role, fixture, secret, workflow, build, or release change.

evidence.local_configuration: All six required release-gate settings are present in the existing private local and production environment files.
evidence.authentication: The configured gate credentials produced a live Supabase session whose returned email matched the configured identity.
evidence.canonical_membership_read: The same session successfully called public.mbr_for_user for organization memberships. It returned 220 active rows, all for the authenticated user, covering 220 distinct organizations. Neither container_id nor organization_id matched the local AIDREAM_GATE_ORGANIZATION_ID.
evidence.approved_fixture: The existing private approved organization fixture has a different ID from the local gate setting. Its organization is among the same identity's current active memberships, with owner role.
evidence.server_read: With that same session and the already approved, confirmed member organization in X-Organization-Id, read-only GET /ci-spend/status returned HTTP 200.

ruled_out: failed password authentication or wrong returned identity
membership RPC permission, schema, or admission failure
lack of current membership in the existing approved organization fixture
authorized_repair_path: At the next local gate preparation, align AIDREAM_GATE_ORGANIZATION_ID in the existing private .env.release.local with the already approved organization fixture, then rerun the canonical gate membership check before using the value. Keep the same gate identity and existing membership; do not create or grant access. The hosted release workflow reads separate AIDREAM_GATE_* GitHub secrets, whose values were not inspected here, so its organization setting must be validated independently before relying on that path.

ci_spend.decision: Actual all-service weekly spend exceeds the cap. The ci-spend policy blocks paid acceptance or release dispatch until the spending block is resolved; no dispatch was made.

limits: No local configuration was edited. The approved fixture's current membership was checked, but its organization row/archive flag was not independently queried in this pass. Hosted GitHub gate secret values and hosted identity membership were not read. No candidate acceptance or release outcome is implied.
